title: PowerVS disaster recovery
blurb: Each backup option is its own network path from on-premises through Direct Link and Transit Gateway. Toggle FalconStor VTL, Compass, and BRMS + ICC independently. In Arrange mode, drag boxes and double-click any box to rename it.
footerHint: Each row is a backup path · toggle options · double-click a box to rename it in Arrange

workspace.label: PowerVS
workspace.summary: PER-enabled PowerVS workspace in IBM Cloud — the DR site. FalconStor StorSafe runs as a separate VSI in this workspace. Compass and BRMS + ICC do not hop through this box on their backup data path; they leave via Transit Gateway into VPC and a VPE.

lpar.label: Recovery VSI
lpar.summary: One virtual server in the DR workspace — the LPAR you fail over to. IBM i here can run BRMS + ICC. FalconStor is a different VSI, not this LPAR.
lpar.sellerNote: This play draws a single recovery LPAR so the DR site is readable. A real workspace can host more VSIs. Do not put FalconStor StorSafe on this same LPAR; StorSafe is its own PowerVS instance.

onprem.label: On-prem
onprem.summary: On-premises Power production. Backup and DR traffic leaves here over Direct Link onto IBM Cloud Transit Gateway.
onprem.sellerNote: This play uses Direct Link as the on-prem circuit. Site-to-site VPC VPN is the fallback when they do not already have a private circuit. PowerVS VPNaaS ended 14 July 2025.

direct_link.label: Direct Link
direct_link.summary: Private circuit from the on-premises site into IBM Cloud. Attach it to Transit Gateway so PowerVS, the customer VPC, and VPEs are reachable without the public internet.
direct_link.sellerNote: If they do not have Direct Link, the same TGW pattern works with site-to-site VPN terminating on a VPC.

transit_gateway.label: Transit Gateway
transit_gateway.summary: Private backbone for the play. Direct Link, the PowerVS PER workspace, and the customer VPC all attach here so backup flows can reach VPC VPEs.
transit_gateway.sellerNote: PER workspaces use network type power_virtual_server. Cloud Connections are the non-PER exception, not the default.

vpc.label: VPC
vpc.summary: Customer VPC that hosts VPEs for IBM Cloud services and, for Compass, the path into the Compass backup VPC. PowerVS reaches this VPC over Transit Gateway.
vpc.sellerNote: This is the landing-zone VPC, not the Compass-managed backup VPC. Do not mix those two.

vpe.label: VPE
vpe.summary: Virtual Private Endpoint in the VPC. FalconStor and BRMS + ICC use a COS VPE. Compass uses VPEs to Compass Vaults in the dedicated backup VPC.
vpe.sellerNote: PowerVS does not host the VPE. Traffic is TGW into the VPC subnet that owns the endpoint.

cos.label: Cloud Object Storage
cos.summary: IBM Cloud Object Storage is the object target for FalconStor deduplicated tape and for BRMS + ICC (5733-ICC) saves. Compass does not land here — Compass Vaults are a separate target.
cos.sellerNote: COS is storage, not the backup product. Do not sell IBM Cloud Backup and Recovery for PowerVS — it is not GA.

falconstor.label: FalconStor VTL
falconstor.summary: FalconStor StorSafe runs as a separate PowerVS instance and presents an iSCSI VTL to IBM i, AIX, and Linux. Long-term store is Cloud Object Storage through a VPC VPE.
falconstor.sellerNote: Use when they already run FalconStor or want to operate the VTL themselves. This is not Compass and not BRMS+ICC writing straight to COS.
falconstor.desc: Partner virtual tape library that runs as a PowerVS instance. Application LPARs talk iSCSI to StorSafe; StorSafe deduplicates into IBM Cloud Object Storage.

compass.label: Compass Managed backup
compass.summary: Secure Automated Backup with Compass. On-prem Power reaches Compass Vaults over Direct Link → Transit Gateway → VPC → VPE. Vaults are not Cloud Object Storage.
compass.sellerNote: Cobalt Iron operated. Dual-copy replicates to a documented DC pair. Do not put other workloads in the Compass backup VPC.

brms_icc.label: BRMS + ICC
brms_icc.summary: Backup, Recovery and Media Services plus IBM Cloud Storage Solutions for i (5733-ICC). The data path is on-prem → Direct Link → Transit Gateway → VPC → VPE → Cloud Object Storage.
brms_icc.sellerNote: Requires 5770-BR1 and 5733-ICC on IBM i. Private COS is the preferred target. AIX uses Storage Protect to COS instead of ICC.
brms_icc.desc: IBM i BRMS (5770-BR1) with Cloud Storage Solutions for i (5733-ICC) sends media to IBM Cloud Object Storage.
